headline: Third quiet day running as the index drifts
body: No scored news again. Endings drifted by a few hundredths as earlier events faded, and Horizon Balance edged up to -2.60. The top three are unchanged: Enslaved God 36.80, Libertarian Utopia 25.18 and 1984 24.64.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Enslaved God -0.05.
